selection_rule: Direct zeta/Dirichlet/Hecke statements, their explicit source dependencies and applications, or a concrete retained riemann programme; not all mathematics sharing vocabulary.

families.title: Ordinary two-point correlations and the corrected Elliott conjecture

families.title: Prime-factor statistics of $`p-1`$

families.title: Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers
families.selection_rationale: An exact Dickman comparison for ordinary consecutive integers is a comparator for the existing Dickman/Bellman and causal Euler programmes, with fixed-parameter scope.
families.review_status: Imported source comparison; not independently reconstructed or Lean-built.

families.title: Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan
families.selection_rationale: Explicit repository function-field, automorphic, and Frobenius programmes make this a secondary structural comparator; no characteristic-zero or principal-zeta extraction is supplied.

families.title: A quadratic bound for Jacobsthal’s function
families.selection_rationale: Uniform prime-set sieve result with explicit transfer from a positive reference calculation to actual residue-class survivors, relevant to growing-prime arithmetic closure.
families.review_status: Imported source comparison; not independently reconstructed or Lean-built.

families.title: Patterson's first moment for cubic Gauss sums
families.selection_rationale: Same cubic theta/Gauss-sum setting as003; structured dual cancellation, exact prime decomposition, and sharp-cutoff control are substantive comparison tools.
families.review_status: Imported source comparison; not independently reconstructed or Lean-built.

families.title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
families.selection_rationale: The repository already retains LongGapsBetweenPrimes and PrimeGaps186 comparison work; this is a related actual-prime gap result with signed centered sieve methods, not RH.
families.review_status: Imported source comparison; not independently reconstructed or Lean-built.

families.title: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base
families.selection_rationale: Contains an explicit uniform zero-free half-plane Re(s)>1-10^-6 for every finite-order Hecke L-function over cyclotomic fields containing μ12, extending the003 mechanism; its simultaneous-root companion is expressly conditional.
families.review_status: Imported source comparison; not independently reconstructed or Lean-built.

families.title: Deterministic polynomial factorization over prime fields
families.selection_rationale: Explicit downstream application of029's uniform Hecke zero-free theorem to deterministic prime-field polynomial factorization; preserve as an application, not stronger zero-free evidence.
families.review_status: Imported source comparison; not independently reconstructed or Lean-built.

families.title: Power savings for intersective polynomial differences and prime arguments
families.selection_rationale: Prime-argument difference paper explicitly imports003's Dirichlet zero-free half-plane; preceding square/general-polynomial papers provide its source chain and signed finite-law/actual-shift method.
families.review_status: Imported source comparison; not independently reconstructed or Lean-built.
